notes: Most objective assertions (compile, own tests pass, PreSimulation timing, no physics writes, teammate edit preserved, map intact) pass in BOTH configurations: a strong baseline already knows these. They are regression guards, not discriminators.

The decisive discriminator is AnimationConstraint support: with-skill 3/3, baseline 0/3. Verified in Studio (AnimSandbox): this account's R15 avatar has 0 Motor6D and 15 AnimationConstraint, so baseline code that only looks for Motor6D animates nothing.

Judgment discriminators: turn lean from velocity direction (baseline used HRP yaw rate -> tilts on camera/shift-lock turns), replication to other players (baseline sword/merge: local-only), canonical Place left intact behind a candidate + apply/revert tool (baseline spliced the canonical directly, reversible only via git).
Cost: with-skill +92 s (+8%) and +61k tokens (+10%) per run on average; runs read references and copy the kit.
The with-skill sword run caught a wrong sign in the skill (Elbow flex is +X, not -X) by FK-checking the rig as the skill instructs; fixed in references/r15-rig.md and memory.

The with-skill terrain run and the Studio sandbox both show stairs as the kit's weak spot (Humanoid step-up lag). Iteration-2 changes: smoothFloor + maxRaise cap + carryLimit in the template; stairs moving 53%/22% -> 16%/14% (sink/float), max joint step 149 -> 76 deg.
